text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On a day off, on the way back from an 
outing...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...Hello there. On your way back from 
somewhere? Looks like you enjoyed your day 
off."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Are you heading to training now, 
Rudolf?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It's hardly something you'd call training. 
If anything, it's more like a change of 
pace.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Of course, I thoroughly enjoy my days off.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, perhaps it is simply my nature, 
but whenever I have free time, I find 
myself wanting to run."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I know the feeling. Whenever I 
have free time, I catch myself thinking 
about running too...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: —And a little about food as well.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I see... Rudolf has training now, does 
she...
choice_data_list: Why don't you go for a run together?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure? ...In that case, I'll go 
change. Please wait a moment.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Running side by side, both put on a 
powerful display.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Adopting similar postures, stretching 
forward with every stride, they duels 
fiercely as they dashed on through..."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Running with someone else really 
is wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Couldn't agree more.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Couldn't agree more.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Maybe that's it. Rudolf's running is 
just, well... amazing.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
That sharp extension, the way she sinks 
low when running... That's why I'm 
watching race footage to learn from it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Haha... Hearing you say that is kind of 
embarrassing.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
However, running form isn't something you 
can easily copy, even if you try.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps we've always had some things in 
common..."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Something similar... Is it that their 
heights are close?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That's not what I mean, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Running alongside Symboli Rudolf seems to 
have contributed to her growth.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Haha... This isn't a run to determine 
victory or defeat, you know.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I wasn't intending to pick a fight 
either.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, but running with you for real might 
actually be a good idea..."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"What do you think? Would you like to run 
a mock race with me sometime?"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
That is... a great honor. I don't even 
know how to thank you...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "Pfft... Bowing to the race... Ahaha!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You tell quite a delightful joke, Oguri 
Cap!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Bowing to the race itself... ufufu! 
Forgive me... ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...? I don't quite understand, but as long 
as you're happy, that's what matters most.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, the race took place as 
promised. Running in a mock race before a 
packed crowd seemed to foster her growth.
